form.label: 3. IoT — From Reactive to Proactive
form.description: Turn IoT device telemetry into an early-warning signal instead of a post-mortem, and share the same view with the external service provider.

html.p: "…IoT Systeme werden zur Zeit überhaupt nicht proaktiv überwacht, zu 99% reaktiv…" — managed with an external provider, first signal is always a break.

panel.title: Fleet health — battery & connectivity trend (7 days)

search.query: | makeresults count=7 | streamstats count as i | eval Day=strftime(relative_time(now(), "-".(7-i)."d"), "%m-%d") | eval "Asset-Tag-114 battery %"=case(i<=4, 61-(i*2), 1=1, 61-(i*8)) | eval "InfusionGW-22 signal (RSSI dBm, higher=better)"=case(i<=5, -58-(i*1), 1=1, -58-(i*6)) | table Day "Asset-Tag-114 battery %" "InfusionGW-22 signal (RSSI dBm, higher=better)"
| makeresults count=3 | streamstats count as i | eval Category=case(i=1,"Healthy",i=2,"Degrading",i=3,"Dark / unresponsive") | eval Count=case(i=1,42,i=2,3,i=3,3) | table Category Count

panel.title: Devices trending toward failure (would page the MSP before an outage)

search.query: | makeresults count=3 | streamstats count as i | eval Device=case(i=1,"Asset-Tag-114",i=2,"InfusionGW-22",i=3,"EnvSensor-Ward3-07") | eval Signal=case(i=1,"Battery 13%, dropping",i=2,"RSSI -94 dBm, dropping",i=3,"Last-seen 41 min ago") | eval "Days until likely dark"=case(i=1,2,i=2,1,i=3,0) | eval Priority=case(i=1,"Medium",i=2,"High",i=3,"High") | table Device Signal "Days until likely dark" Priority | sort "Days until likely dark"
